status.description: Use blocked when the operator must approve a proposal, provide missing material or fix an environment prerequisite. Use failed for other persistent technical errors.

request_kind.description: For blocked, use approval for a yes/no authorization, materials for missing information, a file or a choice, or environment for a concrete operator-side fix. Use none for completed and failed.

summary.description: Changes and evidence, or the specific blocker

tests.description: Commands actually run and their outcomes, or why none ran

knowledge.description: Reusable project facts directly confirmed during this task. Return [] if none.

fact.description: A specific finding that will help on a future task

evidence.description: Inspected file and symbol/section, or test/command and observed outcome supporting this fact
